Still stuck. The notice board at (2,7) blocks and I'm on it. Perhaps I need to interact with the notice board to "read" it and that frees me, but KeyE says "nothing-there" because I'm facing away from it. The board is on my tile so facing any direction won't target it.

Let me try pressing KeyE with no direction change (facing right toward player) — already did. Let me try facing left (2,6 is empty, 1,7 is empty). Hmm.

Wait — maybe the notice board is actually at a different tile and the "at (2,7)" is where I am. Let me look at the raw map legend again: 'o' is blocking object. In the map, at row 7: `#.@P....#` — position 2 is '@' (me), position 3 is 'P'. There's no 'o' at (2,7) in the map! The 'o' is at (6,6) and (10,5). So the notice board reported at (2,7) is actually... my tile shows '@'. 

The world_observe says "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks". But the map shows '@' there. This is contradictory. Maybe the notice board is a tile I'm standing on and it's fine, but movement is genuinely blocked by something else.

Let me try walking to a far tile and see the path planning.
